research.notes: I could not find a credible match for "Emdee Global". The agenda gives no city, no description of the services, and no "dba" name. Searches only returned unrelated organizations: a UK private limited company named Emdee Global Limited, an Indian IT firm called Emdee, and similarly named Oakland or California nonprofits such as Ade's Global Foundation, Emerge Global and Emdad. None of these could be tied to OUSD's Community Schools and Student Services Department or its Expanded Learning Opportunities Program funding. I did not publish a guess. A reviewer could check the board packet's contract for the vendor's address.
